podcast.title: Conflict with DJ Squeaky
podcast.body: A major incident in the Memphis scene occurred when Skinny Pimp assaulted his mentor and producer, DJ Squeaky, with a pistol in a Memphis club. This event, combined with other disputes with DJs, caused a profound split in the early Memphis rap community. "Una noche en un club de mencis, Esquiny acabó golpeando con una pistola sumaestro DJ Squeaky, y tuvo un procedimiento de espados con otros DJs. Aquello dividió la escena en dos."

podcast.title: Early Career & DJ Squeaky Production
podcast.body: Kingpin Skinny Pimp, one of the most fascinating and conflicted figures in Memphis rap, had his first album produced by DJ Squeaky in 1993, which helped establish his local star status. "Es Squeaky produjo el primer disco de King Pingers, que en 1993, uno de los personajes más fascinantes y conflictivos del rap de mencis."

podcast.title: Leader of a Scene Faction
podcast.body: Following the violent confrontation with DJ Squeaky, Kingpin Skinny Pimp, along with Juicy J and DJ Paul, formed one of the two factions that divided the Memphis scene. "y por el otro, Esquiny Pimp, Usj y DJ Poll."
